checks.name: Waiting for the model does not block admission's caller
Duplicate start preserves the original readiness operation
Cancelling joins before a held model writer releases
Availability waits for an accepted model decision
Read cancellation does not release another owner's decision
A wake-up failure cannot discard an available result
Available result is published after model unlock and joined on acknowledgement
An availability exception reaches a terminal result
An availability failure is reported and consumed for retry
A failed preparation permits a fresh readiness request
Releasing the actual model writer produces readiness without a UI timer wait
Repeated readiness cleanup is safe and owns no decision guard
Readiness neither consumes completion actions nor changes the model or catalog
